prompt: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art sprite concept for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a single BOLT DRONE enemy of the Iron Tide, a small storm-chasing arc drone, isolated. A small round cyan sensor eye sits under the prongs, and a little stubby tail fin at the back. Compact ball-with-prongs silhouette. Side view facing left, centered with a generous empty margin on all sides on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background that fills the whole image.
